script_text: Gemini, Mercury squares Saturn this week, forcing you to confront what you've been avoiding. Early week, Mercury trines Jupiter in Cancer, sparking Air-element breakthroughs in your 5th House of self-expression. Tuesday's Moon enters Scorpio, activating your 8th House — shared finances and money shift unexpectedly. Wednesday, Mercury opposes Neptune, so delay contracts until clarity returns. Thursday transforms everything when Venus enters Leo, conjuncting your Sun and flooding the 1st House with romantic magnetism and charm. The weekend Moon in Aries ignites your 9th House — travel or education opportunities emerge. Sunday's Mercury sextile Mars fuels career momentum. Thursday is your power day because Venus enters Leo and conjoins your Sun in the 1st House. Wednesday is your worst day — Mercury squares Neptune, clouding communication in your 3rd House of daily exchanges. Pause before signing any partnership deals until Venus aligns your 7th House. Follow for daily updates.
